name: repairlylabs
description: Dependency-free full-stack mobile repair and spare parts repair enquiries and India-wide part quote platform

scripts.build: node -e "import {readdirSync} from 'node:fs'; import {execFileSync} from 'node:child_process'; for (const f of readdirSync('src')) if (f.endsWith('.mjs')) execFileSync(process.execPath, ['--check', 'src/' + f]);"
